_comment: EXT-63, arm 29 — 12 h, full LV stack + rx_cb_carry_q raised 1e-9 -> 1e-6 m^2/s.
THE MECHANISM TEST for SPEC S14.3, and possibly the cheapest form of its fix.
WHAT S14 FOUND.  Over 12 h the LV stack's level ramps from +4 to +15..+21 TECU
against the time-matched GIM global mean, while the canonical posture wanders in a
-4..-13 band.  S13 says why: the de-meaned carry does not free the receiver-DCB
common mode, it PINS it to mean(x_lin) -- the frozen first-epoch code-bias seed
frame -- with sum(lambda) ~ 100 information units.  Frozen is exactly right at
ignition (LV-1 makes it the physically correct value) and exactly wrong later.
THE KNOB.  The carry's random walk is q = 1e-9 m^2/s: over the whole 12 h that
inflates the carried variance by q*dt = 4.3e-5 m^2 against a posterior var ~1e-2 --
i.e. the carry never forgets anything.  Raising q to 1e-6 gives a forgetting
timescale tau ~ var/q ~ 2.8 h: long enough that within-epoch difference rigidity is
unchanged (over 30 s the inflation is 3e-5 m^2, still negligible), short enough that
the pinned common mode can follow the day.
PREDICTION, STATED BEFORE THE RUN:
- If the frozen pin is the mechanism, the ramp FLATTENS: hours 3-11 should stay
inside roughly +-8 TECU of the GIM instead of climbing to +20, while hour 0 keeps
the stack's good ignition (+4).  That combination -- good ignition AND a settled
level -- is what neither posture achieves today, and it would make the tracking
pin a one-knob fix rather than a new card.
- If the ramp is UNCHANGED, the pin is not the driver and S14.3's mechanism is
wrong; the next suspects are the SH deviation carry (rep_error_tau_s = 900 s is
armed on this lineage) and the leveling-era ratchet the handoff still lists as
inferred.  Say so rather than sweeping q further.
- Watch the carry counters: with a 2.8 h forgetting timescale the LV-4 erase count
should FALL (a looser prior is harder to contradict) and mu should stay ~0.  A
rise in erases means q is now large enough that the carry is chasing noise.
This is a MECHANISM test on a settled window -- do not read its ignition hour as a
verdict, and do not promote the knob off one run.
